slides.title: Full inversion and emphasis
slides.subtitle: Inversion after adverbials of place and so / such
goals: Use full inversion after place adverbials.

head: Pattern
Example
rows: **Down came** the rain. **Here comes** the bus.
**So great was** the demand **that** tickets sold out.
She sings beautifully, **as does** her sister.

items.q: ___ the noise that nobody could sleep.
So popular ___ that it was translated into 40 languages.
